decisions.reason: Eliminating Big Blocks leaves the existing Small Block prize amount, trigger, and eligible population unchanged; the funding split is owned by separate Requirements.
The same-message MODIFY already narrows eligible winners to holders of current Small Block tickets, while the random and provably fair selection rules remain valid.
The same-message MODIFY already removes the Big Block eligibility, post-draw, and counter-independence keys, retains only the Small Block counter, and narrows scope accordingly.
The same-message MODIFY already records the $5 primary-mint allocation and identifies the Small Block prize pool as the active pool; the continuing secondary-sale funding rule is not cancelled.
The same-message MODIFY already replaces the prior Small-and-Big ticket award with a Small Block ticket, and the no-code trigger, recipient rule, and commission remain unchanged.
The same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block references from buyer earnings, prize descriptions, ticket rules, and revenue-split messaging while preserving the remaining FAQ content.
Removing Big Blocks does not change the automatic payout or winner-notification workflow for the remaining Small Block prizes.
The source changes the primary-mint split and removes Big Blocks but does not change the required flat $10 secondary-sale royalty.
The same-message MODIFY already replaces the coded-referral award of Small and Big Block tickets with one Small Block ticket while retaining the $5 commission.
The same-message MODIFY already deletes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter visibility key while preserving the Small Block counter and unrelated metadata.
The same-message MODIFY already records the $15 split into $5 founder, $5 affiliate, and $5 Small Block prize pool allocations and removes the superseded generic funding key.
The generic hero reference to prize draw tickets remains accurate for recurring Small Block prizes and contains no Big Block-specific claim requiring removal.
